searchText: **EIPIP Meeting 91** Date and Time: Oct 04, 2023 at 14:00 UTC Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/278 Feel free to add items for discussion. It's application layer, so an ERC in my mind. Zoom Meetinghttps://us02web.zoom.us/j/82357016731?pwd=V0hLUWIvU2V2UTdUd216WHdGNFBKUT09 The one thing I really have time to care about today is this: > 6. determine the numbering rule for ERCs > > in the short term this will be a spreadsheet where the next sequential number is assigned by an editor. Though this still has issues of number gaming. Alternatively if editors have discretion then there could be a perception of preferential treatment to insiders. I'm not sure how the editor's assigning numbers sequentially is open to gaming, and had thought that we were going to automate this. that was my instinct as well Numbers are assigned sequentially from the spreadsheet but editors can assign to unnumbered EIP/ERCs in any order (which has already happened). So there is potential for the perception of special treatment if a memorable number is assigned out of order. Automation leads to the potential for author gaming to claim a memorable number by submitting a PR quickly (or using a bot) to claim the next sequential number. The EIP/ERC numbering spreadsheet had duplicate numbers. Pretty sure it must have been me dragging the column down and not checking they numbers were sequential. <@474796222738202636> you issued a number that had already been issued. I have issued a new number: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7815 There were two EIP/ERCs awaiting numbers, I believe we should issue in order of when PRs are created, but we don't have a rule on this.

**EIPIP Meeting 91**
Date and Time: Oct 04, 2023 at 14:00 UTC
Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/278

excerpts.author: poojaranjan
excerpts.content: Feel free to add items for discussion.

excerpts.author: abcoathup
excerpts.content: It's application layer, so an ERC in my mind.

excerpts.author: gcolvin
excerpts.content:
The one thing I really have time to care about today is this:
> 6. determine the numbering rule for ERCs
> 
>     in the short term this will be a spreadsheet where the next sequential number is assigned by an editor. Though this still has issues of number gaming. Alternatively if editors have discretion then there could be a perception of preferential treatment to insiders.

excerpts.author: gcolvin
excerpts.content: I'm not sure how the editor's assigning numbers sequentially is open to gaming, and had thought that we were going to automate this.

excerpts.author: joeysantoro
excerpts.content: that was my instinct as well

excerpts.author: abcoathup
excerpts.content:
Numbers are assigned sequentially from the spreadsheet but editors can assign to unnumbered EIP/ERCs in any order (which has already happened).  So there is potential for the perception of special treatment if a memorable number is assigned out of order.

Automation leads to the potential for author gaming to claim a memorable number by submitting a PR quickly (or using a bot) to claim the next sequential number.

excerpts.author: abcoathup
excerpts.content:
The EIP/ERC numbering spreadsheet had duplicate numbers.  Pretty sure it must have been me dragging the column down and not checking they numbers were sequential.

<@474796222738202636> you issued a number that had already been issued.  I have issued a new number: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7815

There were two EIP/ERCs awaiting numbers, I believe we should issue in order of when PRs are created, but we don't have a rule on this.
